verdicts_or_reports.expected: Selecting Transport for the former Groceries expense should move its $40 from Food to Transport in analytics.
verdicts_or_reports.observed: After selecting Transport and saving in the history editor, history shows Transport but the Categories/Total chart still only shows Food. The $40 maximum-spent card also remains Food. Reproduced by restoring Groceries and selecting Transport again.
steps: Open history by swiping down on the main screen.
Expand Groceries ($40, Food), tap Edit, select Transport, and save with the checkmark.
Return to Analytics, choose Categories then Total. Only Food is shown.
Reopen history, restore Groceries, save, then repeat the Transport edit and revisit Analytics; Food remains the only category.

verdicts_or_reports.expected: For $39.97 remaining of $100, show 40% at whole-percent precision, consistent with Available: 40% elsewhere on the same screen.
verdicts_or_reports.observed: Savings shows 39% while available budget shows 40%, for the same $39.97/$100. Reproduced on reopening Analytics and across rotation.
steps: Edit Rent amount from $20 to $20.03 and save; leave the other expense at $40 and budget at $100.
Open Analytics: Spent is $60.03 and Available is 40%.
Scroll to savings: Available: $39.97 but Current savings is 39%.
Leave and reopen Analytics, then rotate landscape and portrait; the discrepancy persists.

verdicts_or_reports.expected: Keep the editor open and preserve the selected date and other draft edits across rotation.
verdicts_or_reports.observed: Rotating to landscape closes the editor and discards unsaved edits. Returning to portrait shows history with the original date and reason. Reproduced twice.
steps: Open history and edit the $40 expense.
Change date from November 12 to November 13 and accept the date, without saving the expense.
The expense editor disappears and the expense remains under November 12.
Repeat the date change and rotation; it is discarded again.
